description: Candidate additions to the METRIC calibration corpus (issue #8). Same schema as metric-corpus.json, so scripts/metric_corpus.py load_manifest reads it. Every label is BLANK ('unassessed') for the maintainer to fill; 'suggested' is a suggestion with its source, never a label and never counted. Nothing is committed but the pins: fetch checks each SHA-256. A namespace document (commit null) is mutable and is pinned by checksum only; fetch fails when it changes.
